sentences.en: The gardener spread new topsoil over the bare patch.
sentences.zh: 园丁把新土铺在空地上。

sentences.en: Topsoil is rich in nutrients that help plants grow healthy.
sentences.zh: 表层土富含养分，有助于植物健康成长。

sentences.en: We need to test the pH level of the topsoil before planting.
sentences.zh: 在种植之前我们需要测试一下表层土的酸碱度。

mnemonic: 合成词：top（顶上的）+soil（土地）→表层土
